title: Historische Methode und Arbeitstechnik der Magdeburger Zenturien: edition of selected documents
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel (edited by Harald Bollbuck; Editiones Electronicae Guelferbytanae 11)
region: Germany (Magdeburg, Jena, Regensburg) and Central Europe
notes: Edition of the letters, plans and reports through which Matthias Flacius and his collaborators organised the Magdeburg Centuries, the first Protestant church history. The introduction counts 154 documents from 1552 to 1568, with commentary and summaries. Each document is a separate TEI file linked from the mets.xml listing at data_url. The edition was published in 2012 and its files have not changed since (start page last modified 2012-11-21), hence archived. The counts cover 153 of the 156 listed files, since 3 files could not be downloaded. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
